cases.title: 点击打开新标签并切换
输入→选择候选→保存草稿

policy: same bounded scripted observer: match visible label/context, at most 6 fresh-snapshot attempts; no DOM eval, CSS selector, screenshot fallback, or site-specific selector supplied to executor
isolation: separate temporary browser profiles; local synthetic fixtures; no personal Chrome, no model keys
excluded: LLM planning, tool-selection decisions, live Amap, connection lifecycle, visual fallback, model token cost
mutation: deterministic controller arms same replacement; stale-ref safety intentionally refreshes snapshot before using old ref
